newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Saurer sees profit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Saurer sees profit growth in 1997.

text.p: Textile machinery and automobile components groups Saurer AG said it expected profit growth through the rest of 1997 after a weak first quarter.
"The prospects for 1997 are good," Saurer said in a letter to shareholders.
"After a weak first quarter, orders in hand and delivery plans lead us to expect a continuation of positive profit development in the second quarter and in the second half of the year," Saurer said.
Saurer said it was particularly confident because of positive results from customer testing of a new spinning machine due to be introduced to the market late this year.
The new machine should lead to sustained profit improvements in this business sector in 1998, Saurer added. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7341
